meta.name: product-sense-interview-answer
meta.description: Structure a spoken PM product-sense answer with assumptions, segmentation, pain-point prioritization, and MVP tradeoffs. Use when practicing design, improve, or build-next interview questions.

copy.tagline: 结构化回答产品面试中的设计、改进类问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备产品经理面试，需要练习结构化回答。
copy.tagline_en: Structure your PM product-sense interview answers with assumptions and tradeoffs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for PM interviews and need to practice structured answers.

howto.what: Claude 会用六步框架帮你组织产品感面试的回答:先澄清问题、说明理由、定产品目标,再细分用户、挑主要痛点,最后比较方案选 MVP。它防止你一开始就堆功能。
howto.when: 当你练习产品设计、产品改进或“下一步做什么”这类面试题时触发,比如“你会怎么改进 YouTube?”。

say.text: 咱们模拟一次产品设计面试:请改进 YouTube,针对初学者。
say.note: Claude 会按六步框架引导你回答。

say.text: 我要练一道产品改进题:为航空恐惧的旅客设计产品。
say.note: 它会先帮你理清目标和用户。

say.text: 帮我用这个框架回答‘DoorDash 下一步做什么’,限时 25 分钟。
say.note: 它会给你一个结构化的口述答案。

howto.what_en: Claude uses a six-step scaffold for product-sense answers: clarify, rationale, goal, segmentation, pain points, solution choice. It keeps you from jumping to features before defining the user and problem.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you practice product design, product improvement, or 'what to build next' interview questions, e.g., 'How would you improve YouTube?'

say_en.text: Let's mock a product design interview: improve YouTube for beginners.
say_en.note: Claude will walk through the six-part scaffold.

say_en.text: Practice: design a product for travelers with flight anxiety.
say_en.note: It will help clarify scope and target user first.

say_en.text: Use this framework to answer 'What should DoorDash build next?' in 25 minutes.
say_en.note: It will structure the answer and pick one MVP.
